gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya reads with wide, easy s turns and a lowercase that towers over its own capitals, friendly and unfussy. Warnes, stretched and bold, brings the drama.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Warnes draws every stroke like a bent straw, tapering away before the lines can touch, with generous tracking. And Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong follows in a tall-set, modern sans whose rounds gap open, so a long passage moves along without fuss.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Expressive and loud, Warnes lays down a marker-nib line that ignores direction, while Noto Sans Palmyrene keeps its curves stopping short. Try nothing fancy here.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau keeps its curves open and its capitals close. Over a long stretch it reads smoothly, with little height jump between letters, while Warnes stays flamboyant above it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Warnes looks like glass tubing bent into letters, stretched wide and bold, with strokes that taper out before they meet. Noto Sans PhagsPa gives it a friendly plain sans to rest against.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Noto Sans Phoenician has generous lowercase height and s curves that open wide at both ends, so it feels modern and spacious. A long passage in it would flow easily beneath Warnes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahla: Approachable at the text level, Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping mouths on its e and capitals that barely rise, while Warnes draws with a plotter pen. That gap in personality is the pair's strongest card.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Warnes has no thick-and-thin at all, just one steady line that tapers before it touches. And Noto Sans Rejang does the quiet work, its wide portholes of lowercase carrying the text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-runic: Warnes bends its strokes like steel rod, stretched wide with no swelling in the line. Noto Sans Runic does the reading work, with a big x-height and curves that never close.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: A bent paperclip, blown up and bold. Noto Sans Samaritan below it has a hefty lowercase and curves full of daylight, so a long passage reads comfortably under Warnes.
